problem: SEO opportunities could create duplicate content or optimize traffic without enough connection to orders, revenue, canonical intent ownership and production proof.
root_cause: Search-demand signals, cannibalization controls, conversion outcomes and canonical money-page ownership were not represented as one durable operating rule across the SEO opportunity loop and agent skill layer.
prevention: INTENT_OWNER_FIRST: when a canonical money or pillar page already owns the search intent, improve that owner before proposing new content.
NEW_CONTENT_REQUIRES_DISTINCT_INTENT_GAP: a blog or landing page may be proposed only when no existing canonical owns the intent and cannibalization has been checked.

SEO_REVENUE_PRIORITY: prioritize opportunities using commercial or transactional intent, search demand, CPC, trend, ranking gap, conversion gap, order rate and revenue rather than traffic volume alone.
DAILY_OPPORTUNITY_BOUND: rank at most five evidence-based SEO opportunities per daily cycle and prefer the smallest action with the clearest path to lead, order or revenue.
CANNIBALIZATION_CONSOLIDATION: duplicate or typo URLs must be consolidated into one canonical owner with internal references, sitemap/RSS/index cleanup and permanent redirect when appropriate.
INTERNAL_AUTHORITY_IS_CONTEXTUAL: strengthen money/support pages with relevant contextual internal links, not random sitewide link injection.
BOUNDED_MARKET_DATA: use existing Search Console evidence first and use paid DataForSEO calls only for bounded high-value gaps; never do estate-wide polling without evidence.
LIVE_PROOF_REQUIRES_RUNTIME_IDENTITY: merge is not terminal; verify the exact current production deploy identity and public page behavior before claiming LIVE & BEWEZEN.

DELIVERY_METADATA_USES_CANONICAL_LANES: PR metadata must use only delivery lanes allowed by config/powerhouse-delivery-hygiene-v1.json; domain labels such as seo-growth or seo-content are not delivery lanes.
implementation: Revenue-oriented SEO opportunity scoring implemented in PR #2389.
Keyword cannibalization between onprijsd and ongeprijsd URLs consolidated in PR #2396.
Contextual internal authority for /excel-als-crm strengthened in PR #2399.
Canonical learning is projected automatically through scripts/brain/powerhouse-skill-projection.mjs.
Dedicated .agents SEO revenue skill documents durable execution behavior.

The external web index reader still surfaced cached HTML for some pages immediately after deploy, and the direct container had no DNS; this cache limitation is recorded rather than treated as contradictory production identity.
